correctness.rationale: The one-positive exponential-density formula gives \(V/V_{\min}=\sec\theta/\prod_{j=2}^n(1-\kappa v_j)\) with tangent coordinates of zero sum and unit square sum. For \(f(x)=\log(1-\kappa x)\), the admissible angle range keeps all factors positive and gives \(f'''<0\). The quadratic Hermite interpolant at the sharp lower coordinate bound \(b\) and repeated point \(r\) has remainder \(f(x)-Q(x)=f'''(\xi)(x-b)(x-r)^2/6\le0\). Summing \(Q\) depends only on the fixed first two moments, giving the exact product maximum; equality forces coordinates in \(\{b,r\}\), and zero sum forces one \(b\) and the rest \(r\). Fresh symbolic expansion independently reproduced the stated quadratic and cubic coefficients, while fresh random tangent tests in dimensions \(3\) through \(9\) corroborated the inequality without serving as proof.
correctness.risk: The theorem stops exactly when the equality geodesic reaches a chamber wall; no post-wall radial envelope is proved.
